extracted.course_title: Ethics, Communication, and Tools for Software Development

prerequisites.evidence: Prerequisite: grade C or better in CSC 210 or equivalent
Prerequisite: grade C or better in English 214 or equivalent

other_requirements.evidence: Prerequisite: grade C or better in CSC 210 or equivalent; grade C or better in English 214 or equivalent

learning_outcomes: To gain practical experience in thinking through everyday ethical situations involving technology.
To improve effective written communication in the context of computer science and software development.
To develop the ability to talk about and discuss issues in computer science, one on one and in a group setting.
To become familiar with basic tools used in SW development.
To move beyond the question of "how to code" toward an understanding of "why we code."
topics: failures and risks of new technology

skills.evidence: This course explores the ethics of technology and how to live a good life while surrounded by gadgets and gizmos. In doing so, we'll focus on the finer points of abstract ethical reasoning as well as the nitty gritty of real-world applications

To become familiar with basic tools used in SW development.
